strings.name: Nadine Labaki
strings.summary: Raised amid war in Lebanon, Labaki studied audiovisual arts and moved from commercials and music videos into features. Caramel examines women’s intimacy and constraints; Where Do We Go Now? addresses sectarian conflict; Capernaum uses children’s and migrants’ situations to question social responsibility. She also acts and participates in international film culture.
